findings.location: native_styled_runtime.py LiveSession.execute.original_execution and unchanged materialized run_prebuilt_native_ui16.py run, post-Popen lines98–132
findings.problem: worker_finished proves that the Python call/thread ended, not that an exception after spawning reaped the xcodebuild process or closed its group. The original run function has no guaranteed post-Popen finally: command-receipt write, disk sampling, log flush or evidence failure can raise before its ordinary timeout cleanup and group observation. LiveSession catches the exception, sets worker_finished, joins the thread, and rethrows; main then enters styled restoration and simulator shutdown with no actual process-group terminal proof. This can leave the owned xcodebuild alive and race final settings/device actions.
findings.requiredBoundary: Retain this exact original source and add a separately reviewed, finite post-Popen exception-cleanup boundary for commands used by this future live path. Resolve the owned process/group before treating worker completion as lifecycle completion; preserve the initiating exception separately from cleanup errors and never infer absence from thread completion. No need to rerun any old UI/native tests.
